convertibility_reason: Martingale position sizing with margin-dependent lot calculation and progressive multiplier on losses. This is a high-risk grid-adjacent strategy that relies on MT5 account/margin functions and broker-specific execution for recovery trades, making it unsafe and impractical to auto-convert to Python backtesting.

derived_values.name: MACD histogram color state (4-color coding: bullish rising, bullish falling, bearish rising, bearish falling)
derived_values.formula: MACD_line - Signal_line comparison with prior bar direction

other_exits: Opposite MACD signal closes existing position before opening new one in reverse direction

position_sizing.conditional_logic: On losing trade, next lot = previous_lot * LotMultiplier. On winning trade, lot resets to base LotSize. Lot size is also capped by free margin check via OrderCalcMargin or equivalent.

custom_logic_notes: Four-color MACD histogram provides visual and logical distinction between momentum phases: (1) bullish + rising histogram = strong long, (2) bullish + falling histogram = weakening long/exit, (3) bearish + falling histogram = strong short, (4) bearish + rising histogram = weakening short/exit. The martingale lot multiplier compounds risk on consecutive losses. Margin check prevents over-leveraging but does not prevent account drawdown from martingale sequence. SL/TP pip values require digit adjustment (multiply by 10) when _Digits==5 or _Point<0.001.
python_conversion_notes: The martingale position sizing is the primary blocker for auto-conversion. Must implement: (1) trade result tracking to determine win/loss for lot sizing, (2) margin calculation equivalent to OrderCalcMargin for lot validation, (3) four-color MACD histogram state machine for entry/exit signals, (4) digit adjustment logic for SL/TP pip-to-price conversion. The MACD indicator itself is standard and can use ta-lib or pandas-ta. The 4-color logic is a derived state from standard MACD histogram direction changes. Backtesting must use tick data or M1 with realistic slippage since martingale recovery depends on fill quality.
